title: Withdrawal requests through deposit pool lost permanently
summary: _Resolved_  ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `requestWithdrawal()` function in `ElytraDepositPoolV1` creates withdrawal requests that will be permanently lost due to incorrect user address tracking. When a user calls `requestWithdrawal()`, the deposit pool transfers the user's elyAsset tokens to itself and then calls the unstaking vault's `requestWithdrawal()` function:  ```solidity     function requestWithdrawal(         address asset,         uint256 elyAssetAmount     )         external         nonReentrant         whenNotPaused         onlySupportedA
